rooms.name: Deep within the Forest
rooms.desc:
The trees grow thick in this part of the woods, swallowing up any
luminescence, and plunging you into eternal green twilight. All around, you
see a huge mountain range rising into the sky.

rooms.name: Deep within the Forest
rooms.desc:
You practically chop and hack your way through the thick underbrush and
treacherous game trails, hoping that you have managed to not get lost in
these woods. All around, you see a huge mountain range rising into the sky.

rooms.name: Deep within the Forest
rooms.desc:
While traveling through the forest, you suddenly notice how deathly quiet
it is. It seems almost as if the thick, twisted branches and roots have 
swallowed up all signs of animal life and plunged you deep into another
alien world of green. All around, you see a huge mountain range rising high
into the sky.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
You make your way easily through these well traveled woods, following
trails made by loggers, trappers, and animals. To the north and west, a
massive mountain range looms over you.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
You have decided to follow one of the more traveled paths through the 
forest, and are able to make good time. Birch trees, and various cedars
grow tall and straight beside you. To the north and west, an enormous 
mountain range towers into the sky.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
You are in a lightly wooded forest. As you walk along, you catch glimpses
of the tall mountains to the north and west. North of here is the entrance
to a small valley in the mountains.

rooms.name: Deep within the Forest
rooms.desc:
As you travel through the woods, the birch trees begin to give way to
great sequoias. These towering monoliths stare down at you in contempt. You
wonder if they have been here since the creation of the world. To the north
and west, you see a mountain range rising up and up.

rooms.name: The Great Western Road
rooms.desc:
You are traveling on the great western road. The cobblestone road looks
ancient, but the wear and tear is minimal due to the regular maintenance.
To the north and south, a forest opens up before you. To the west, the 
road comes to an abrupt halt at the foot of a towering mountain range. 
You wonder why this road comes out here.

rooms.name: The Great Western Road
rooms.desc:
You are traveling on the great western road. The cobblestone road looks
ancient, but the wear and tear is minimal due to the regular maintenance.
To the north and south, a forest opens up before you. Not far to the 
west, you see a mountain range rising into the sky.
